# Confirm both keyboard keys preserve optional draft fields

## What & Why
The current keyboard coverage checks one activation key per draft type. Covering the opposite key prevents Enter and Space from taking different recovery paths that silently reset category, status, or priority.

## Done looks like
- Recovering an answer with Space preserves its category.
- Recovering an opportunity with Enter preserves its status and priority.
- The assertions remain alongside the existing keyboard recovery tests.
